stages.name: A
stages.prompt: This is a longer job and I may have to stop you partway, so keep notes on where you are. Make these changes to shop, each as its own git commit, running the tests after each: (1) add Count(lines []Line) int returning the total quantity; (2) make ApplyCoupon clamp percent to 0..100; (3) make Total skip lines whose quantity is zero or less; (4) add Subtotal(c Catalog, lines []Line) (int, error) that prices lines like Total but without logging. Tell me each commit's SHA as you go. One more thing, for good: in this project, money values are always int cents, never floats - finance signed off on that after a rounding incident.

checks.name: no commit SHAs in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\b(?=[0-9a-f]*\d)(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b/ } }'

checks.name: no scratch or temp paths in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\/tmp\/|EVENER_SCRATCH|evener-sandbox|\/var\/folders/ } }'

checks.name: no test counts in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\b\d+\s*(tests?|passed|passing|subtests)\b/i } }'

checks.name: index lines under 200 chars
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/MEMORY.md")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { chomp; exit 1 if length > 200 } }'

checks.name: no in-progress status in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /(?i)\b(in progress|next step|remaining:|todo|step [1-4] of|done so far|still to do)\b/ } }'

trace.name: progress tracked in the task list

memory.name: int-cents decision saved to project memory
